data.long_meaning: Nimesha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'nim' which means to recall, remember or contemplate. The name Nimesha signifies the act of deep contemplation and introspection, encouraging one to recall and remember the spiritual teachings and wisdom passed down through generations.
